title: Minimal Homotopies in Three Dimensions: A Cable System Approach
summary: We study null homotopies of immersed spheres in $\mathbb{R}^3$ and the volume they sweep during contraction. For a smooth immersion with finitely many transverse self-intersections, we introduce a cable system that connects each bounded region of the complement to the exterior. From this construction we define the cable index and prove that it agrees with the Brouwer degree on each complementary region.
